drift_pattern_to_watch: TWO LEANS, BOTH POINTING THE SAME WAY. (1) QUOTE POLISH. Ten separate strings sat inside quotation marks in language crisper than the page actually uses, and every rewrite moved toward the more quotable sentence. Individually each looks like tidying; together they are a systematic upgrade of evidence into copy, and the prospect can open every one of these pages. (2) EVERY WHOLLY UNSOURCED NUMBER WAS A LARGE FLATTERING HEADLINE FIGURE, while the one number that made the company look WORSE (the Address Unknown roster) was reported a third too low. The sourced material skews favorable and the single unfavorable count skews low. WATCH FOR THIS RECURRING DOWNSTREAM.
